unit.explanation: Each record is a unique LARC patient in the validation cohort (P81-P128)

platform.explanation: Patient-derived rectal cancer organoids (RCOs) used for assay

readout.explanation: Assay readout is ratio of organoid size on day 24 post-treatment to day 0

direction.explanation: Lower size ratio indicates higher sensitivity to combined chemoradiation

threshold_rule.explanation: Fixed cutoff of 34.87% size change ratio, derived from discovery cohort

threshold_timing.explanation: Threshold was pre-specified using the separate discovery cohort, not optimized on the validation cohort

patient_mapping.explanation: One-to-one mapping between organoid lines and patients, clinical outcomes available for all 48 validation patients

regimen_match.explanation: Organoids were treated with the same combined chemoradiation regimen as patients

n_units.explanation: Total 48 patients in the validation cohort

split.explanation: Validation cohort is separate from the discovery cohort used to set the threshold

notes: Reported accuracy matches computed value 45/48 = 0.9375; organoid size ratio data for individual validation patients is available in supplementary Table S2 (supp.pdf page 10-12)
